name: Continuwuity-Matrix
description: A fast, lightweight Matrix homeserver written in Rust

paths.name: Continuwuity
paths.description: The RocksDB database: all rooms, messages, media and accounts. This is the only data the server has, so back it up.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Matrix client and federation API, published on host as 6146. Put an HTTPS reverse proxy in front of it to federate with other servers.

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: CONTINUWUITY_SERVER_NAME
variables.description: Your Matrix server's name, like matrix.example.com. It becomes part of every user name (@you:matrix.example.com) and can never be changed without deleting all data, so set it before the first start. For use at home only, your server IP and port work too, like 192.168.1.20:6146.

variables.name: CONTINUWUITY_DATABASE_PATH
variables.description: Where the database is kept inside the container. Leave it as /var/lib/continuwuity.

variables.name: CONTINUWUITY_ADDRESS
variables.description: The address the server listens on inside the container. Leave it as 0.0.0.0.

variables.name: CONTINUWUITY_PORT
variables.description: The port the server listens on inside the container. Leave it as 8008.
